entities.summary: The State of Brazil or Government-General of Brazil was one of the states of the Portuguese Empire in the Americas during the period of Colonial Brazil. in force between 1548 and 1815. Created in the context of the reorganization of the Portuguese imperial system in the Atlantic, its central purpose was to centralize the administration of the hereditary captaincies, ensure the defense of the territory, and consolidate royal authority over the southern portion of the Crown's American domains.
